verses.geez:
ወተጋብኡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴፊና ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለይፍታሔ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ሖርከ ፡ ትትቃተሎሙ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወኢጸዋዕከነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንሑር ፡ ምስሌከ ፤ ናውዒ ፡ ቤተከ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ በእሳት ።
verses.translation: And the men of Ephraim assembled themselves, and passed on to the north, and said to Jephthae, Wherefore didst thou go over to fight with the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house over thee with fire.

translations.lxx: And the men of Ephraim assembled themselves, and passed on to the north, and said to Jephthae, Wherefore didst thou go over to fight with the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house over thee with fire.
translations.kjv: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
translations.ron: După aceea s-au adunat Efraimiţii şi au purces spre Ţafon şi au zis către Ieftae: "Pentru ce te-ai dus să te baţi cu Amoniţii, iar pe noi nu ne-ai chemat cu tine? Vom arde dar casa ta cu foc, împreună cu tine".

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ይፍታሔ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ግፉዕ ፡ አነ ፡ ወሕዝብየ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ሣቀዩነ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወጸራኅነ ፡ ለክሙ ፡
                  ወኢያድኀንክሙነ ፡ እምነ ፡ እዴሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And Jephthae said to them, I and my people and the children of Ammon were very much engaged in war; and I called for you, and ye did not save me out of their hand.

translations.lxx: And Jephthae said to them, I and my people and the children of Ammon were very much engaged in war; and I called for you, and ye did not save me out of their hand.
translations.kjv: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
translations.ron: Iar Ieftae a zis: "Eu şi poporul meu am avut cu Amoniţii ceartă mare şi eu v-am chemat, dar voi nu m-aţi scăpat din mâinile lor.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘያድኅን ፡ አግባእክዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ወዐደውኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡
                  ዐሞን ፡ ወአግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ዐረግሙ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ዮም ፡ ትትቃተሉኒ ።
verses.translation: And I saw that thou wert no helper, and I put my life in my hand, and passed on to the sons of Ammon; and the Lord delivered them into my hand: and wherefore are ye come up against me this day to fight with me?

translations.lxx: And I saw that thou wert no helper, and I put my life in my hand, and passed on to the sons of Ammon; and the Lord delivered them into my hand: and wherefore are ye come up against me this day to fight with me?
translations.kjv: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
translations.ron: Văzând însă că nu este nici un izbăvitor, mi-am pus viaţa în primejdie şi m-am dus împotriva Amoniţilor şi Domnul i-a dat în mâinile mele. De ce dar aţi venit să vă bateţi cu mine?"

verses.geez:
ወአስተጋብኦሙ ፡ ይፍታሔ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ወተቃተሎሙ ፡ ለኤፍሬም ፡ ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ገላአድ ፡
                  ለኤፍሬም ፤ እስመ ፡ ይቤልዎሙ ፡ ድኁናነ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.translation: And Jephthae gathered all the men of Galaad, and fought with Ephraim; and the men of Galaad smote Ephraim, because they that were escaped of Ephraim said, Ye are of Galaad in the midst of Ephraim and in the midst of Manasse.

translations.lxx: And Jephthae gathered all the men of Galaad, and fought with Ephraim; and the men of Galaad smote Ephraim, because they that were escaped of Ephraim said, Ye are of Galaad in the midst of Ephraim and in the midst of Manasse.
translations.kjv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
translations.ron: Atunci a adunat Ieftae toţi oamenii din Galaad şi s-a bătut cu Efraimiţii şi au bătut locuitorii Galaadului pe Efraimiţi, zicând: "Voi sunteţi nişte fugari din Efraim, Galaadul însă e între Efraim şi Manase".

verses.geez:
ወበጽሕዎሙ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘኤፍሬም ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡
                  ይቤሉ ፡ ድኁናነ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ንዕዱ ፡ ይቤልዎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ አንትሙኒ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ አንትሙ ፡
                  ወይቤሉ ፡ ኢኮነ ።
verses.translation: And Galaad took the fords of Jordan before Ephraim; and they that escaped of Ephraim said to them, Let us go over: and the men of Galaad said, Art thou an Ephrathite? and he said, No.

translations.lxx: And Galaad took the fords of Jordan before Ephraim; and they that escaped of Ephraim said to them, Let us go over: and the men of Galaad said, Art thou an Ephrathite? and he said, No.
translations.kjv: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
translations.ron: Şi au luat Galaaditenii vadul Iordanului de la Efraimiţi şi când vreunul din Efraimiţi zicea: "Îngăduie-mi să trec", atunci oamenii din Galaad îi răspundeau: "Nu cumva eşti Efraimit?" Acela răspundea: "Nu!"

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ በሉ ፡ ማሕፀን ፡ ወአበዩ ፡ ብሂለ ፡ ወአኀዝዎሙ ፡ ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወወድቁ
                  ፡ እምነ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ይእተ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አርባዕቱ ፡ እልፍ ፡ ወዕሥራ ፡ ምእት ።
verses.translation: Then they said to him, Say now Stachys; and he did not rightly pronounce it so: and they took him, and slew him at the fords of Jordan; and there fell at that time of Ephraim two and forty thousand.

translations.lxx: Then they said to him, Say now Stachys; and he did not rightly pronounce it so: and they took him, and slew him at the fords of Jordan; and there fell at that time of Ephraim two and forty thousand.
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
translations.ron: Ei însă îi ziceau: "Zi: Şibbolet"; el însă zicea: "Sibbolet", că nu putea zice altfel. Atunci ei îl luau şi-l junghiau acolo la vadul Iordanului. Şi au căzut în vremea aceea din Efraimiţi patruzeci şi două de mii.

verses.geez:
ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ይፍታሔ ፡ ስድስተ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ ይፍታሔ ፡ ገለአዳዊ ፡ ወተቀብረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡
                  ገላአድ ።
verses.translation: And Jephthae judged Israel six years; and Jephthae the Galaadite died, and was buried in his city Galaad.

translations.lxx: And Jephthae judged Israel six years; and Jephthae the Galaadite died, and was buried in his city Galaad.
translations.kjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
translations.ron: Şi a fost Ieftae judecător în Israel şase ani; apoi a murit Ieftae Galaaditeanul şi a fost îngropat în unul din oraşele Galaadului.

verses.geez: ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ፡ ሔሴቦን ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ልሔም ።
verses.translation: And after him Abaissan of Bethleem judged Israel.

translations.lxx: And after him Abaissan of Bethleem judged Israel.
translations.kjv: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
translations.ron: După el a fost judecător în Israel Ibţan din Betleem.

verses.geez:
ወወለደ ፡ ፴ደቂቀ ፡ ወ፴አዋልደ ፡ እለ ፡ አስተዋሰበ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ወ፴አንስተ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ለደቂቁ ፡ እምነ ፡ አፍአ ፡
                  ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ፯ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent forth; and he brought in thirty daughters for his sons from without; and he judged Israel seven years.

translations.lxx: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent forth; and he brought in thirty daughters for his sons from without; and he judged Israel seven years.
translations.kjv: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
translations.ron: Acesta a avut treizeci de feciori şi treizeci de fete a dat el din casa sa în căsătorie, iar treizeci de fete a luat de afară pentru fiii săi şi a fost judecător în Israel şapte ani.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ሔሴቦን ፡ ወተቀብረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ልሔም ።
verses.translation: And Abaissan died, and was buried in Bethleem.

translations.lxx: And Abaissan died, and was buried in Bethleem.
translations.kjv: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
translations.ron: Apoi a murit Ibţan şi a fost îngropat în Betleem.

verses.geez: ወኰነኖሙ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ኤሎም ፡ ዛቡሎናዊ ፡ ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ፲ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And after him Ælom of Zabulon judged Israel ten years.

translations.lxx: And after him Ælom of Zabulon judged Israel ten years.
translations.kjv: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
translations.ron: După dânsul a fost judecător în Israel Elon Zabuloneanul şi a judecat pe Israel zece ani.

verses.geez: ወሞተ ፡ ኤሎም ፡ ዛቡሎናዊ ፡ በኤሎም ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ዛቡሎን ።
verses.translation: And Ælom of Zabulon died, and was buried in Ælom in the land of Zabulon.

translations.lxx: And Ælom of Zabulon died, and was buried in Ælom in the land of Zabulon.
translations.kjv: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
translations.ron: Apoi a murit Elon Zabuloneanul şi a fost înmormântat la Aialon, în pământul lui Zabulon.

verses.translation: And after him Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, judged Israel.

translations.lxx: And after him Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, judged Israel.
translations.kjv: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
translations.ron: După el a fost judecător în Israel Abdon, fiul lui Hilel Piratoneanul.

verses.geez:
ወተወልዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ፵ደቂቅ ፡ ወ፴ደቂቀ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወይጼዐኑ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ፸አዕዱግ ፡ ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ሰመንተ ፡
                  ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And he had forty sons, and thirty grandsons, that rode upon seventy colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

translations.lxx: And he had forty sons, and thirty grandsons, that rode upon seventy colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
translations.kjv: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
translations.ron: Acesta a avut patruzeci de fii şi treizeci de nepoţi care călăreau pe şaptezeci de mânji de asin şi a judecat pe Israel opt ani.

verses.geez:
ወሞተ ፡ ለቦን ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤሎም ፡ ኤፍራቶናዊ ፡ ወቀበርዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኤፍራት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ደብረ ፡ ለነቅ ።
verses.translation: And Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, died, and was buried in Pharathon in the land of Ephraim in the mount of Amalec.

translations.lxx: And Abdon the son of Ellel, the Pharathonite, died, and was buried in Pharathon in the land of Ephraim in the mount of Amalec.
translations.kjv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
translations.ron: Apoi a murit Abdon, fiul lui Hilel Piratoneanul şi a fost îngropat în Piraton, în pământul lui Efraim, pe muntele lui Amalec.
